title: 铜线升级而已：竟拖垮全美航空，背后是否另有原因？
speaker: John Pistole

segments.en: Joining us now is John Pistol. He's former administrator for the TSA and former deputy director of the FBI.
segments.zh: 现在加入我们的是约翰·皮斯托尔。他是前TSA局长，也是前FBI副局长。

segments.en: Nice to see you again, sir. I think my first question is, really, I mean, it is shocking to me that this can be brought down by a single point of failure
segments.zh: 很高兴再次见到您，先生。我的第一个问题是，真的，这让我震惊，一个单点故障就能导致这样的瘫痪，

segments.en: and what we're being told is a routine upgrade of copper, wiring, and some routers.
segments.zh: 而我们被告知，这只是铜线、布线和一些路由器的例行升级。

segments.en: Does it do you buy that? Yeah, but I'll tell you what, it's scary.
segments.zh: 您信吗？是啊，但我告诉你，这很可怕。

segments.en: If that is the actual cause of all this mess that we've had this weekend, which continues, as we know, it's not all clear, as they say.
segments.zh: 如果这就是本周末所有混乱的实际原因，而且混乱还在继续，正如我们所知，事情并未完全明朗。

segments.en: And so my concern as many people thinking, okay, is that the root cause?
segments.zh: 所以我的担忧，正如许多人在想，好吧，这是根本原因吗？

segments.en: This too much traffic being put over this copper wire on this upgrade to the fiber output?
segments.zh: 是不是在这次升级到光纤输出的过程中，过多的流量被放到了这条铜线上？

segments.en: And I guess my question gets back to, was there something behind that that they haven't disclosed or simply don't know about, which is you may be scarier, to say, okay,
segments.zh: 我想我的问题又回到了，背后是否有什么他们未披露或根本不知道的事情，这可能更可怕，也就是说，

segments.en: there was something that prompted this and then that spread.
segments.zh: 有什么东西引发了这件事，然后扩散开来。

segments.en: And given all the other things going on in the world, I just think it would be hopeful to have more information as to, was there something behind that?
segments.zh: 考虑到世界上发生的所有其他事情，我只是认为，如果能获得更多信息，了解背后是否有什么原因，那将是充满希望的。

segments.en: And especially on a Friday afternoon, two 10 days before Thanksgiving rush, it's not the busiest time of year for air traffic and it will be.
segments.zh: 尤其是在周五下午，距离感恩节高峰还有十天，这并非航空交通最繁忙的时段，但接下来会变得繁忙。

segments.en: And so what happens now in the next week, 10 days, the Wednesday before and the Sunday after Thanksgiving to the busiest travel days in the year going from two million passengers
segments.zh: 那么接下来一周、十天，感恩节前的周三和节后的周日，是一年中最繁忙的出行日，客运量从每天两百万人次

segments.en: a day in the U.S. to almost three million. So there's, there's a number of unanswered questions that I would like to know more about. I think most people would.
segments.zh: 增至近三百万人次。所以有许多未解之谜，我想了解更多，大多数人也是如此。
